title: Arson High Flare Solid
lines: The overall strength of the Arson High Flare Solid makes this the strongest ball in our historic Arson line.
The 3000 Abralon finish is perfect for medium oil patterns. Although we don’t think you will need it, this one takes surface adjustments easily to handle larger volumes of oil.
Our Modified Arson 2 core utilizes our original Arson core design with modified densities to create a stronger overall ball reaction.
Our Max-Hook cover was featured on the original Arson series. This solid version provides a strong yet predictable ball motion.
